input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Item 4 suggests module-weight/module-exclusive for each venture, but `grep <slug>` over docs/history misses passes titled by another name (einvoice-preflight's are 'einvoice-page-perf' / 'ci-perf-...-einvoice'); I nearly picked a venture with 6 earlier passes. suite_file_times lists them; a page-side equivalent would help.
HTTP/1.1 only, so Chromium's six-connection limit hides part of any gain from parallel fetching; the live site is HTTP/2.

Its small server calls writeHead twice when a read fails after the 200 header (ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT), so it crashes when served a built page that requests site-chrome files; I ran it with the source HTML.

notes: Metric: module-worker graph load time, from new Worker() to the last module request answered, measured against platform/perf/revalidate-serve.mjs (150 ms per request, live-site headers) in headless Chromium, median of 5, cold and warm (304). Before = build of origin/main 0ef08aacd, after = this branch; same 3-venture --only build. Cold: league bowling 1089->777 ms, practice 1085->621, suggest 939->627, round-check 930->624, carryover 782->473, race 622->470; changepoint analyze 1248->1074, consensus 1082->779; shift-roster roster 647->481. Warm is within about 15 ms of cold. Request counts are unchanged. Full build: 14 workers flattened, 110 imports; an acorn check gives 0 mismatches. ai-bookkeeper suite timed per file first (119.8 s summed, 31.7 s wall at 4 jobs, max 3.7 s): no outlier, so it was not changed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), fetched 2026-11-12. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. Sonnet 5.5 cache_read was 0.20 here until 2026-11-12 (quality audit round 48): records priced before then overstate Sonnet 5.5 cost.

human_equivalent.basis: senior web perf engineer: diagnose worker waterfall, build pass, tests, browser bench, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
